title: Tensor products of globally generated invertible sheaves are globally generated
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $n\ge 1$ be an integer, and let $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_n$ be globally generated invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Then the tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] $\mathcal L_1\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\cdots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L_n$ is a globally generated invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module, generated by the tensor products of finite global generating families of the factors.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09NC proof, tensor-product construction; Properties Lemma 28.27.4 (properties-lemma-tensor-product-globally-generated)

proof.text: By induction on $n$, the tensor product $\mathcal L_1\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\cdots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L_n$ is invertible. Here the $n$-fold tensor product is the iterated one, $\mathcal L_1\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_n=(\mathcal L_1\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_{n-1})\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L_n$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For $n=1$ there is nothing to prove; for $n\ge 2$ the first factor is invertible by induction and the tensor product of two invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules is invertible by [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor] (1).

Choose finite global generating families for each $\mathcal L_i$, as supplied by global generation. The tensor products of these sections generate the tensor product module by [lem-sc-tensor-generating-sections]. Hence the tensor product is globally generated, and the displayed tensor products are a generating family.
